Indulge in the allure of Abide on 30A. Recently reimagined, it boasts three elegantly appointed bedrooms and three luxurious bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to eight discerning guests. Revel in the contemporary design, the inviting fireplace, and the unique bunk room. Its privileged position between the sophisticated Alys Beach and the Watersound community promises an unforgettable family retreat, complete with direct beach access, a refreshing swimming pool, and breathtaking ocean views

The space
Welcome to Abide on 30A, a beautifully renovated coastal retreat located on the quiet east end of Scenic Highway 30A. Nestled in the peaceful Arcadia community between Watersound, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach, this thoughtfully designed townhome offers the perfect blend of relaxation, comfort, and convenience for your next beach getaway.

One of the home’s best features is the easy beach access located directly across the street, making beach days effortless. No long walks, no driving, and no hauling gear—just a short stroll to the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf on the deeded beach access with private beach chair rental available (March 1 - October 31)!

After a day at the beach, return to a calm and welcoming space designed for gathering and unwinding. The open living and dining area allows everyone to spend time together while still enjoying comfortable separation of space.

Whether you’re enjoying morning coffee before a beach walk, relaxing after a day in the sun, or heading out to explore the charming nearby communities, Abide on 30A is designed to help you slow down and truly enjoy the rhythm of the coast.


About the Home

Abide on 30A offers approximately 1,600 square feet of thoughtfully designed coastal living space, comfortably accommodating up to 8 guests. The home blends relaxed beach style with modern comfort, making it an ideal retreat for families or small groups looking to experience the beauty of Scenic Highway 30A.

Main Living Area
The main living level is designed for comfort, connection, and relaxed coastal living. This bright, open-concept space seamlessly blends the kitchen, dining area, and living room, creating a welcoming environment where everyone can gather throughout the day.
The kitchen is both beautiful and functional, featuring bright cabinetry, quartz countertops, warm brass accents, and modern appliances. A large island with seating for four provides the perfect place for morning coffee, quick breakfasts before the beach, or gathering while meals are prepared.
Just beyond the kitchen, the dining area comfortably seats six beneath a striking statement chandelier. Surrounded by large windows and soft coastal drapery, the space is filled with natural light throughout the day.

The living room anchors the space with a large sectional sofa ideal for relaxing after a beach day. Soft neutral tones, warm wood textures, and touches of ocean blue reflect the calming colors of the coast. A sleek electric fireplace and large wall-mounted TV make it perfect for cozy evenings, movie nights, or simply unwinding together.
French doors off the living room open to the porch, where guests can enjoy the coastal breeze, sip morning coffee, or relax in the evening after a day on the sand.

Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 8)

Primary Suite – Downstairs
The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat designed for rest after full days along the coast. Soft coastal tones, natural textures, and large windows create a calm atmosphere that reflects the relaxed rhythm of 30A.
The room features a comfortable king bed with plush bedding, bedside lighting, and two lounge chairs at the foot of the bed—perfect for reading or enjoying a quiet morning coffee. Built-in cabinetry and storage make the space comfortable for both short and extended stays.
The ensuite bathroom provides a spa-like experience with a double vanity, quartz countertops, warm wood cabinetry, and brass fixtures. A spacious walk-in shower finished in beautiful coastal blue tile brings the colors of the Gulf indoors.

Bunk Room – Downstairs
The custom bunk room is designed with families in mind and sleeps up to four guests. Built-in bunks provide a fun and comfortable space for kids, cousins, or friends to share during their beach vacation.
Bright windows and coastal accents keep the room feeling light and airy, while built-in drawers beneath the bunks provide convenient storage for luggage and beach gear. A wall-mounted TV and cozy seating area make it a great place for younger guests to unwind after a day in the sun.
A nearby hallway bathroom offers easy access and added convenience.

Guest Bedroom – Upstairs
The upstairs guest bedroom provides a quiet and comfortable space designed with the same coastal aesthetic found throughout the home. Soft neutral tones and natural textures create a relaxing environment ideal for winding down after a day at the beach.
The room features a queen bed with plush bedding and a deep coastal-blue upholstered headboard, along with large windows that bring in natural light. Guests also have convenient closet storage and access to a nearby bathroom with a walk-in glass shower and bright modern finishes.

Location Highlights
Abide on 30A is perfectly positioned on the east end of Scenic Highway 30A, placing guests close to some of the area’s most beautiful beaches, dining, and coastal communities.
The home sits directly across from convenient beach access, making it easy to spend the day enjoying the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf without long walks or loading up the car.
Guests are also just minutes from several of 30A’s most iconic destinations:
• Alys Beach – known for its stunning white architecture and upscale dining
• Rosemary Beach – charming streets, boutique shopping, and local restaurants
• The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) – a lively gathering spot with restaurants, live music, and family-friendly entertainment
• Watersound – scenic bike paths and beautiful coastal views
Whether you’re heading out for coffee, dinner, beach time, or an evening stroll, everything that makes 30A special is just a short bike ride or drive away.

What Guests Love

✓ Beach access directly across the street
✓ Quiet east-end 30A location
✓ Neighborhood pool
✓ Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Watersound
✓ Comfortable layout for families and groups
✓ Peaceful retreat away from crowded areas

Nearby Destinations

A short drive or bike ride connects you to some of 30A’s most loved destinations, including:

• Alys Beach
• Rosemary Beach
• Watersound
• Seacrest Beach
• Scenic 30A bike path
• Local restaurants, coffee shops, and boutiques

Whether you’re here for beach days, bike rides along Scenic 30A, or simply time together by the coast, Abide on 30A offers a peaceful place to relax, reconnect, and enjoy the best of 30A living.
